requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to filter appointment types and see clinician summaries.
A dedicated section for repeat prescriptions must be provided, allowing patients to see current medications and select multiple renewals.
Patients must be able to provide notes or comments with their prescription requests.
The test results section must provide a list of recent tests with user-friendly explanations of results.
Automated notifications must be sent to patients when their test results are available.
The portal must have a clean and straightforward design with intuitive navigation.
A tutorial or guided walkthrough for first-time users must be included.
The portal must include a help or FAQ section to address common issues and questions.
Multiple support channels including chat, phone, and email must be available for assistance.
Accessibility features such as text resizing and screen reader compatibility must be included.
The system must comply with GDPR for customer data storage.
